name: ASL Express – Touchless AI Food Ordering Assistant
tagline: Order food in sign language: a camera reads the signs and a counter device confirms the order with lights and sound.
problem: Drive-thrus and counters are frustrating for deaf and mute customers, the team says.
solution: MediaPipe recognises signed letters mapped to menu items, repetitions set quantity, a thumbs-up confirms, and an ESP32 shows the order on an LCD with LEDs and a buzzer.
demo_moment: Team-described: sign B twice and thumbs-up to order two fries.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Closes the loop with a physical confirmation at the counter.

lessons: A small fixed vocabulary makes a sign-recognition demo reliable.
